label: Viperin system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a prokaryotic viperin locus represented by a pVip profile that can produce antiviral modified ribonucleotides and protect against phage infection.
observations: Viperin branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual pVip genes, prokaryotic or eukaryotic viperin proteins, radical-SAM enzymatic activities, individual modified ribonucleotide products, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Viperin locus, unresolved accessory genes, and other phage defense systems.
